content.summary: A weatherproof courier boot moves from wet-route need to three material proofs and a READY lockup. Preserve the five causal invariants, stable spatial anchors and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: Performance context precedes the product reveal. + The complete product profile remains recognizable. + Each macro proves one named function. + The user action visibly exercises those functions. + The final hero frame reunites product, proof and exact short copy.
quick_start.recommended_input: Show an original adult night courier sprinting across a charcoal depot floor with one reflective parcel strap. Use three macros to prove sole grip, sealed seam and ankle support with precise amber highlights. Center the complete boot beside the exact original word READY and hold the functional proof.
